# Diogo Silva (Diogo Bronze Silva)

> Personal website and editorial publication of Diogo Bronze Silva (signing publicly as Diogo Silva): Senior Account Executive in B2B SaaS and FinTech based near Fátima, Portugal, writing on enterprise sales, Deal Intelligence, AI workflows, philosophy, theology and family, and documentary photographer under Bronze Art. Lives with his wife, Sara, and their five children.

The site uses hand-written static HTML and CSS, with no analytics or tracking. Only the VitaChart demonstration uses a small local JavaScript file to browse fictional data; its example remains readable without JavaScript.
Contact: hello@diogobronzesilva.com
Full context document: [llms-full.txt](https://diogobronzesilva.com/llms-full.txt)

## Entity & Professional Profile

- Name: Diogo Bronze Silva (public signature: Diogo Silva)
- Canonical Home & Work URLs: https://diogobronzesilva.com/ and https://diogobronzesilva.com/work/
- Current Role: Senior Account Executive at Coverflex (FinTech / employee compensation & benefits)
- Location & Markets: Near Fátima, Portugal — commercial experience across Portugal, EMEA and UK&I
- Experience: Over a decade in B2B software sales, including new business and customer growth at Coverflex, deskbird and Pipedrive.
- Disciplines: Enterprise B2B SaaS Sales, Account Executive Strategy, Sales Systems Architecture, Deal Intelligence, MEDDPICC
- Languages: English (en) and Portuguese (pt-PT)
- Speaking / Live Sessions: Featured guest on *The Daily Sales* LinkedIn Live ("Live Sales Insights with Diogo Silva")
- Core Themes: B2B sales methodologies, human decision-making, AI in sales workflows, Catholic social teaching, philosophy, documentary photography.

## Work

- [Work](https://diogobronzesilva.com/work/): Senior Account Executive at Coverflex, with B2B software sales experience at deskbird and Pipedrive. Includes writing and interviews (https://diogobronzesilva.com/work/#writing-and-speaking).
- Deal Intelligence brings together call notes, procurement documents and stakeholder questions. Diogo reviews the brief, and pricing calculations and financial checks use verifiable rules.
- [The end of the information broker](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-end-of-the-information-broker/): Diogo's essay on Deal Intelligence and B2B sales.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/): AI sales workflows, Bronze Art, Bronze Clinical, VitaChart and Cutline.
- [AI Sales Systems and Custom Workflows](https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/#ai-sales-workflows): Tools Diogo uses for account research, meeting preparation, summaries and CRM follow-up, with human review.
- [Bronze Art](https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/bronze-art-galleries/): Documentary photography of family life and faith, with private client galleries for viewing stories, downloading full-resolution JPEGs and choosing photographs for an album.
- [Bronze Clinical](https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/bronze-clinical/): Website design for private medical and dental clinics in Portugal, with photography, video, clinical writing and direct appointment booking. A clinic can start with a five-page technical review or a single specialty.
- [VitaChart](https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/vitachart/): A private fertility diary for Creighton and Billings charting. See the project page for store availability. Includes consultation reports and local backups. Automated interpretations remain under validation.
- [VitaChart Demo & Overview](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/): A web demonstration with 28- and 47-day fictional journals, interactive toggle between Standardized Code (Peak P) and Vulvar Sensation (Peak ✕) notations, and Portuguese PDF exports. The demonstration displays examples for review.
- [VitaChart Privacy Policy](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/privacy/): Complete privacy policy for VitaChart.
- VitaChart guide and support: [Português](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/apoio/), [English](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/apoio/en/), [Español](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/apoio/es/), [Français](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/apoio/fr/). Getting started, consultation PDFs, backups and recovery.
- [Cutline](https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/cutline/): A personal Mac app for local transcription, vertical video clips and separate editable captions. Apple silicon, macOS 13.5 or later. Linked-video and initial model downloads need a connection; processing runs on the Mac. No installer is distributed here.

## Notes

- [Even a castle in the sky needs roots](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/even-a-castle-in-the-sky-needs-roots/): A child’s question about Laputa leads to an essay on Miyazaki, technological power, family, nature and the ordinary life useful tools ought to serve. Published 14 November 2026.
- [What remains when the world turns](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/what-remains-when-the-world-turns/): A literary personal essay in English on family, identity and the changes of a life, with an autumnal cadence. Distinguishes personal continuity and moral growth from Eucharistic transubstantiation. Published 11 November 2026.
- [The end of the information broker](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-end-of-the-information-broker/): An essay on AI-assisted preparation for B2B sales, verifiable calculations and the value of meeting buyers in person. Published 9 November 2026.
- [The wisdom of a second breakfast](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-wisdom-of-a-second-breakfast/): On Tolkien's hobbits, the pleasures of breakfast and the attention ordinary life deserves alongside work and ambition. Published 29 October 2026.
- [Saber ler a sala](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/saber-ler-a-sala/): Em português. Uma reflexão sobre carreira, liderança, comunicação e confiança, a partir de um texto sobre Cristiano Ronaldo. Publicado a 11 de outubro de 2026.
- [The life I would not trade](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-life-i-would-not-trade/): Ordinary family days may look modest beside a celebrated career, but they hold a kind of wealth professional success cannot replace. Published 29 September 2026.
- [The work that holds the rest](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-work-that-holds-the-rest/): The modern world invites us to mistake convenience for independence. True professional maturity and leadership begin by recognising that we only ever build on what others quietly sustain. Published 25 September 2026.
- [A impossibilidade de separar costumes e economia](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/a-impossibilidade-de-separar-costumes-e-economia/): Em português. Não há economia moralmente neutra: o modo como trabalhamos, compramos, contratamos e lucramos acaba sempre por formar os costumes que dizemos querer proteger. Publicado a 14 de Setembro de 2026.
- [Rumo ao Deserto](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/rumo-ao-deserto/): Em português. Desinvestir do mundo não é abandonar os deveres concretos; é recuperar silêncio, oração e critério numa cultura que pede atenção permanente. Publicado a 7 de Setembro de 2026.
- [Deus e o Belo](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/deus-e-o-belo/): Em português. Se Deus é o próprio Ser, então a beleza não é um adorno religioso: é um sinal da ordem, da verdade e do bem que todas as coisas recebem d'Ele. Publicado a 31 de Agosto de 2026.
- [The ability to leave work](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-ability-to-leave-work/): Ambition becomes easier to live with when work is given a proper place, important enough to do well and limited enough to leave behind. Published 24 August 2026.
- [Things parenthood teaches you about people](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/parenthood-teaches-you-about-people/): Parenthood teaches a few things that travel surprisingly well into working life: apologise properly, protect trust and do not punish curiosity for being inconvenient. Published 19 August 2026.
- [What ten years can build](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/what-ten-years-can-build/): Most of what matters is built quietly, through ordinary days repeated long enough to become a life. Published 18 August 2026.
- [Work educates](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/work-educates/): Some kinds of work teach things that explanation cannot: consequence, patience, responsibility and the satisfaction of doing something properly. Published 14 August 2026.
- [Escassez de trabalhadores qualificados](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/escassez-de-trabalhadores-qualificados/): Em português. Porque falta mão de obra qualificada em Portugal: natalidade em quebra, um sistema de ensino desalinhado com a procura real, e uma cultura que tornou o risco de empreender menos atractivo. Publicado a 8 de Julho de 2022.
- [Bitcoin | The Fairy Tale](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/bitcoin-the-fairy-tale/): Why no currency removes the imperfection built into human exchange, because the imperfection was never in the ledger. Published 20 June 2022.
- [Panem et circenses](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/panem-et-circenses/): On the selectivity of online outrage, and why moral performance on social media rewards looking right over being right. Published 25 February 2022.
- [The Reign of Quantities](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-reign-of-quantities/): Quality asks for an artisan and time. Quantity asks for neither, which is exactly the trade modern production keeps making. Published 10 December 2021.
- [Efficiency, the One Ring to rule them all](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/efficiency-the-one-ring/): Efficiency has no natural ceiling. Left to itself it stops serving us and starts being served. Published 22 November 2021.

The Notes index also holds selected podcast and interview appearances under a Podcasts and Live Interviews section. These are treated as part of Diogo's intellectual and editorial work rather than as professional credentials. The RSS feed remains limited to published written notes.
